Configure restore settings, manage disk space, and delete restore points.

12.title: System Protection

controls: By enabling system protection, you can undo undesired changes by reverting your computer to a previous point in time.
Using system protection on a drive that contains system image backups will cause other shadow copies to be deleted faster than normal
You can adjust the maximum disk space used for system protection. As space fills up, older restore points will be deleted to make room for new ones.
Delete all restore points for this drive.
Type a description to help you identify the restore point. The current date and time are added automatically.
